results.summary: Tucked away on a quiet residential road in the heart of Enfield, this beautifully presented two-bedroom ground floor flat perfectly blends period character with modern convenience. Boasting a private rear garden and spacious interiors, this home is an ideal find for small families, or those looking to downsize without compromising on outdoor space. The property welcomes you with a bright and airy reception room, centered around a stunning original cast-iron fireplace with decorative tiling, a true focal point that adds warmth and historical charm. Large bay windows flood the space with natural light, highlighting the rich, exposed original floorboards that run through much of the home. Adjacent to the living area, the modern galley-style kitchen is both stylish and functional, featuring sleek cabinetry, ample workspace, and integrated appliances. It provides direct access to the garden, making it perfect for indoor-outdoor entertaining. The family bathroom is equally impressive, finished with crisp tiling and a contemporary white suite including a full-sized bath with a glass screen. The sleeping quarters consist of a generously proportioned main bedroom featuring neutral tones, high ceilings, and a large window overlooking the lush greenery of the rear garden. The second bedroom is a versatile space that functions perfectly as a guest room, a quiet home office, or a nursery, also showcasing authentic wooden flooring. One of the standout features of this property is the expansive private rear garden. The garden offers a peaceful escape with a mix of lawn and patio areas, perfect for summer barbecues, gardening enthusiasts, or a safe play area for children. This home offers the convenience of ground-floor living with a private entrance, dedicated front garden area, and easy access to local amenities and excellent transport links. Internal viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the rare combination of characterful period detail and essential modern outdoor living. LOCATION The property is perfectly positioned to enjoy the best of Enfield's vibrant community and abundant green spaces. Nature lovers will appreciate being within easy reach of the historic Forty Hall Estate, which offers beautiful parkland, lakes, and a farm, as well as the scenic Hilly Fields and the New River Loop, ideal for weekend strolls or morning runs. For fitness enthusiasts, the David Lloyd Club and the Southbury Leisure Park are both nearby, providing top-tier sports and swimming facilities. Shopping and dining options are plentiful, with the extensive amenities of Enfield Town just a short distance away. Here, you'll find a mix of popular high-street brands in the Palace Gardens Shopping Centre, alongside independent boutiques, traditional markets, and a diverse selection of cafes and restaurants. For daily essentials, several local supermarkets and convenient food stores are located within half a mile. +1 Commuters are well-served by excellent transport links. The property is ideally situated for access to both Enfield Town and Enfield Chase stations, offering frequent and direct overground services into Central London (Liverpool Street and Moorgate). Numerous bus routes operate nearby, providing easy connections across North London, and the A10 and M25 are quickly accessible for those travelling by car. Families will also value the selection of highly-regarded local schools in the immediate area, including Lavender Primary and Chace Community School, both within comfortable walking distance. results.summary: A stylish one bedroom apartment with a large private terrace, on the first floor of Lock View House, a designer canalside development. You're moments from the green expanse of Victoria Park, and just fifteen minutes on foot from Hackney Wick station. Inside you'll find clean lines, clever zoning and over 500 square feet of well-arranged space, including a generous kitchen/living room and full-sized bathroom. *Please note, photos shown are of a show flat in the building. Layout may vary* IF YOU LIVED HERE... Step inside for a wide hallway with high ceilings, soft grey walls and ash blonde engineered hardwood underfoot. The open plan kitchen and reception takes in over 400 square feet, with an L shaped suite of kitchen cabinets, sleek and white, plenty of room to lounge. Outside, your south facing timber decked terrace makes for a wonderfully relaxing space in the heart of the city. Your bedroom sits across the hall with more blonde timber flooring and soft neutral decor. You've got around 140 square feet of tranquil space here, with a large fitted wardrobe and floor to ceiling window. The bathroom is fully finished in sleek white metro tilework, rainfall shower over the full sized tub, oversized vanity mirror and heated chrome towel rail. The development sits just moments from the canal and a five minute stroll from Old Ford Lock. You're less than fifteen minutes from both Victoria Park and Hackney Wick station, where you'll find a legendary open boating lake and fast overground links across the capital, respectively. The Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park is just across the river, for world class sports facilities, renowned landmarks and endless sweeping greenery. WHAT ELSE? - Hackney's former warehouse district, these days Fish Island is home to an ever evolving range of diverse wining and dining spots. Try floating fine dining at Barge East. - In keeping with the building's heritage, the iconic steel frame is still apparent, adding some signature industrial flair to your new development. - Westfield Stratford is less than twenty minutes' walk across the park for endless shopping and leisure possibilities.
